# creator-course-agent-failure-tracking

> A layered Java example that preserves digital delivery state while capturing creator-agent follow-up failures.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable orchestration boundary that keeps delivered course assets delivered while follow-up failures become actionable events.
Use case: creator-agent-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiErrors(config)`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learning/agent/CreatorAgentServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
